name: ske-io/php-bridge
description: Runs PHP applications on SKE: HTTP, queues and console

suggest.aws/aws-sdk-php: Required on AWS for the default ske queue connection, which sends jobs to SQS.
suggest.inertiajs/inertia-laravel: Required only for applications opting into Inertia SSR.
suggest.laravel/framework: Laravel 11, 12 or 13. The bridge integrates with it automatically when it is installed.
suggest.laravel/octane: Required at ^2.22 in production dependencies when enabling Octane HTTP execution on AWS.
